legacy_stats_clean_sheets_range.name: legacy_stats_clean_sheets_range
legacy_stats_clean_sheets_range.value: clean_sheets is null or clean_sheets between 0 and matches

seasons_date_order.name: seasons_date_order
seasons_date_order.value: ends_on is null or ends_on >= starts_on

match_players_penalties_saved_valid.name: match_players_penalties_saved_valid

generated.as:
case
          when goals_for > goals_against then 'W'
          when goals_for < goals_against then 'L'
          when went_to_penalties and penalty_score_for > penalty_score_against then 'W'
          when went_to_penalties then 'L'
          else 'D'
        end

matches_penalty_scores_presence.name: matches_penalty_scores_presence
matches_penalty_scores_presence.value:
went_to_penalties = (penalty_score_for is not null)
        and went_to_penalties = (penalty_score_against is not null)

matches_penalty_scores_valid.name: matches_penalty_scores_valid
matches_penalty_scores_valid.value:
not went_to_penalties or (
        penalty_score_for >= 0
        and penalty_score_against >= 0
        and penalty_score_for <> penalty_score_against
      )
